column3: The fleshly weapons become weapons of the world; demolishing arguments is in verse 5.
Demolishing arguments from verse 4 is placed here; “presumption” interprets every height.
Readiness is expressed in the future.
The purpose is recast as not wanting to seem to frighten them.
“Some say” makes the speaker plural; “unimpressive” replaces weak.
“Field of influence” explains the assigned area.
“The first” is supplied with reaching them.
The area of influence becomes the subject of increasing.
